en.accept: They took their children and fled.
When they came to the river, there was no boat.
When they came to Yamatu, there was no ferryman.
Many Kalmyks came and (camped at|stopped at|fell upon) the (city|town).
A place called (the Stone Pass|Tash Daban).
When they went to Toqquz Tara, there were no Kalmyks.
(They|He|She) (camped|stopped) at a place called Chapan Bashin.
